summary: Master data-driven decision making in social protection. Learn to optimize targeting, M&E, and G2P systems using advanced analytics. Enroll today.
lede: Data-driven decision-making in social protection uses administrative records and household surveys to inform program design and day-to-day decisions. It is for professionals managing or analyzing social assistance and insurance data who need to improve beneficiary targeting and resource allocation. Training covers Proxy Means Test validation, social registry data-quality checks, and monitoring and reconciliation of digital benefit payments.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is designed for professionals who manage or analyze social assistance and insurance data systems.
modules: Social Protection Data Ecosystems and Lifecycle
Social Registry Management and Data Quality
Monitoring and Evaluation for Social Impact
Digital G2P Payments and Financial Inclusion
Visualizing Social Data for Policy Influence
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in social policy, public administration, or M&E. Familiarity with basic statistical concepts and spreadsheet software (Excel) is required. Prior exposure to social assistance program operations is highly recommended.
